hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the parameterized factor template F_x(n)=K(n)*x(n). The two additive terms are obtained by substituting x=a and x=b, respectively.
required_assumptions: K, a, and b are unary functions of n
The two products share the same K(n)
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical terms share the exact factor K(n) and differ only in the second factor, so they are instances of a single parameterized product kernel K(n)*x(n).
